customManagers.description: Home Assistant add-on base images in Dockerfiles
GitHub runner versions in shell scripts and YAML within workflows
Renovate npm package version pinned in CI workflows

APT packages pinned in Debian 13 (trixie) Dockerfiles, tracked against the Debian archive via the deb datasource (resolves binary package names directly — no per-package source mapping). depName excludes '_' since Debian package names can't contain underscores (avoids matching Python kwargs like 'exist_ok=True' in heredocs).

Tag-pinned WeeWX extensions installed from GitHub archive zips in the Dockerfile. Commit-SHA pins (matthewwall extensions) are intentionally not matched (no upstream tags) and tracked via scripts/check-updates.sh.

packageRules.description: Resolve pinned Debian apt packages against the trixie archive (main + updates + security), matching the base-debian image's apt sources.
rtgd's version is also baked into a hardcoded unzip PREFIX in the Dockerfile, so an automated URL bump would silently break the build. Track it manually via scripts/check-updates.sh.

Pin Python to the 3.13 series — it must match python3 in the Debian trixie base image. Bumping to 3.14 makes uv build a standalone 3.14 venv that mismatches the base's apt python3 (broke the build). Lift this when the base moves to a Debian release with 3.14.
